text: Hello, I hope this is the right number. I'm a childminder and I've got a little boy, he's 2, staying with me overnight because his mum is working a night shift and I can't get hold of her at the moment. I took his temperature about twenty minutes ago and it was 38.3, which I think is a fever? I'm not completely sure what counts. His eczema has also flared up really badly today, dry rough itchy patches on the backs of his knees and the insides of his elbows, and he keeps scratching them. I don't know if the eczema and the temperature are connected or if that's just a coincidence. He is weeing fine, I've changed two wet nappies this evening, so I don't think he's drying out or anything. I just feel very responsible because he's not mine and I'd hate to have missed something. Should I be giving him something for the temp, or putting cream on the patches, or does someone need to look at him tonight? Sorry for the long message, I'm just quite worried.
